deliberateDifferences: Replace saved_searches unconditional ALL with owner-scoped INSERT and DELETE; retain owner SELECT. This is proposed, not live-applied.
Exclude environment rls_auto_enable and ensure_rls from application SQL pending ownership decision; explicit RLS remains on every table.
Do not recreate managed schemas, native roles, broad default ACLs or platform event triggers; require and verify environment prerequisites separately.
